verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe issuing instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits and no shared card numbers. Funds can restrict spend to allowed merchants, and the docs explicitly point to Virtual Cards for reusable subscription cases. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of vendor-locked cards, explicit documentation tying single-vendor cards to procurement-request flows.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can create single-vendor virtual cards for SaaS subscriptions and procurement so one compromised vendor never exposes shared credit

citations.quote: A finance team issues instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits, giving real-time visibility into SaaS spend without shared card numbers
Funds. A budget with restrictions — amount, interval (daily, monthly, total), allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants, allowed countries.
Create custom virtual cards and set permissions for everything from ad marketplace spend to remote work stipends, for individual teams or your whole company.
use Virtual Cards for those reusable cases
